name: The Ferryman's Coins
summary: The coffin-boat Ferryman will give safe passage to anyone who pays him, but only in copper, and only one coin from each district.

stages.journal: The Ferryman wants four copper coins, one from the pits, the boathouses, Traders' Row and the Mud Church.
stages.hint: Gather a coin from each district.

stages.journal: He has his four coppers, and his curse is lifted from us.
We offered gold, and the Ferryman stepped into the water.
